resources.string: Phone storage is at /sdcard in new sessions.
Close a session before opening another.
This erases Ubuntu, every installed package and every file in it, then downloads a fresh copy. Phone storage is not touched.

Termant %1$s

A real Ubuntu 24.04 userland on your phone, without root. Install software with:

 apt update
 apt install <package>

Tap AI for OpenCode, an AI coding agent that can write and run code for you.

Pinch to change text size. Long-press to select and copy.

Open source (GPLv3). Terminal by Termux, userland by PRoot, system by Ubuntu, agent by OpenCode.
